preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of officers is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The initial coordinate of Chef is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.
The initial coordinates of the officers are between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: P_i != C for all 1 <= i <= N
preconditions.description: No officer is initially at Chef's coordinate.

preconditions.expression: P_i != P_j for all 1 <= i < j <= N
preconditions.description: No two officers are initially at the same coordinate.

postconditions.expression: output is a list of two integers
postconditions.description: The output consists of two integers separated by a space, the first being the maximum number of officers that can be eliminated and the second indicating whether Chef runs away or gets caught.

postconditions.expression: the first integer is the maximum number of officers that can be eliminated
postconditions.description: The first integer represents the maximum number of officers that Chef can eliminate.

postconditions.expression: the second integer indicates Chef's fate
postconditions.description: The second integer is 1 if Chef runs away, and -1 if Chef gets caught.

invariants.description: Chef and the officers take turns moving, with the officers moving first.

invariants.expression: officers move to adjacent unoccupied cells
invariants.description: Officers move to adjacent unoccupied cells, and if they cannot move, they are eliminated.

invariants.expression: Chef moves to adjacent unoccupied cells or gets caught
invariants.description: Chef moves to an adjacent unoccupied cell or gets caught if he cannot move.

invariants.expression: no two officers can be in the same cell
invariants.description: At no time can two officers be in the same cell.

invariants.expression: no officer can be in the same cell as Chef
invariants.description: At no time can an officer be in the same cell as Chef.
